positions.title: New Product Introduction Intern
positions.description:
Worked with managers to improve production test implementation and shorten time to production
o Created CAD based documentation for production purposes, finalized BOMs, assembled product and delivered to Australia.
• Point of contact for all production/operational questions/issues for multiple programs

positions.title: HIP Intern
positions.description:
Created the foundation for sUAS applications with 3DR’s Y-6. 
	Created manuals and tests for future users and applications
	Worked towards deriving payload capacity, solving energy efficiency
	Ran tests for swarming multiple sUAS that will allow for multiple perspective EO/IR situational awareness and distributed payloads for enhanced mission effectiveness
	Mainly in charge of analyzing the autonomous swarming capabilities of the sUAS and testing them

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Academy of Music and Arts for Special Education
volunteerExperiences.description:
Assisted children with autism by opening up a new vision through music and art. 
Taught violin, piano and percussions to children who showed passion in music as a new way of communicating. 
Taught children how to draw and sculpt different things that allowed them to find a new way of expressing themselves.
